en.name: Gibraltar Industries PASGT ballistic helmet
en.description: The Gibraltar Industries PASGT (Personal Armor System for Ground Troops) is a Ballistic combat helmet based on the classic U.S. military PASGT design. Offers dependable protection against shrapnel and small-caliber threats, though heavier and bulkier than modern alternatives.

en.name: Revision BATLSKIN Cobra ballistic helmet (MTP)
en.description: The Revision BATLSKIN Cobra ballistic helmet is a High-cut ballistic helmet offering superior protection with modern comfort features designed for the British Armed Forces.
